title: 第九十四章 恶魔第九十三章 战斗暴龙兽
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
三代心中复杂之极！震撼的道“曾经宇智波斑，一人独战百万大军，流传为了传说！忍者再强，怎么强的过千军万马？可是这波风冥帝和当日宇智波斑一样，做到了！”
团藏也是眼眸惊愕的都快跳出来了！他知道波风冥帝实力可怕，可也没想到可怕到了这种地步！
若是早让团藏知道波风冥帝地真正实力，强大到了这种骇人听闻的地步！就是杀了他地头也不会就此树立如此强敌！此等人物。岂是好得罪地？
这不是找死吗？
团藏没想到自己算计了一辈子，居然算错了波风冥帝的真正实力！正思量之间。波风冥帝已经越来越近！
千军万马地厮杀依然在持续。
波风冥帝手中流离若火，散布着可怕火焰，一刀过去，不知要烧死多少人。
但波风冥帝的冷眸所看的不是被他杀死的人。
波风冥帝所看的，那是山坡上的大名，三代，团藏！
这三个人，波风冥帝已经在心里下了必死令！这三个人，已经不得不死了！
此刻波风冥帝全身从上到下，已经变得一片血红！波风冥帝自然没有受伤，还没有一个人可以让波风冥帝受伤！
那都是敌人地鲜血。
在火之国众将士眼中。这个高速移动着的血红身影，便是地狱血海之中突然钻出来的一个无可匹敌的恶魔。所行之处，所到之处，只见得一大片一大片残肢断体，只闻得一阵阵腥风血雨，只听得一段段最凄厉的惨叫哀号！
波风冥帝面前所有敌人看到这个恐怖无比的恶魔冲了上来，均是忍不住浑身颤栗，眼神惊惧之极！人可以与人争，就算那个人是强人、恶人、高人都可以一争，但人却无法与魔争！尤其是眼前的绝世狂魔，实在太恐怖了！
现在火之国的一些军士居然连举起刀剑的手也在簌簌颤抖，在波风冥帝可怕气势所摄之下，早已战意全无，心中唯一的想法便是掉头就跑！如此军士，如此士气，还有什么杀伤力可言？
“快放箭！快放箭呀！射死他！！射死哪个恶魔！！！快快快…….”山坡之上，大名惊吓从地上爬起来，跳起脚来，声嘶力竭地大吼！声音之中，早已掺杂了数不清的惊惧恐怖之意，隐隐竟然带上了几丝哭腔！
大名已经快要哭出来了！
他惹谁不好，偏偏惹上了波风冥帝！大名这辈子还没有那么后悔过！
但他身边的传令军士却是一脸的为难。毕竟现在波风冥帝等人已经是完全和火之国的军队混杂在了一起，箭矢这种大范围攻击利器如何能够轻易奏功？火之国的弓箭手不可能都是传说中的神箭手，就算是神箭手也不可能在如此环境下不出纰漏，若说真要以箭枝来歼敌，除非将自己人也进行无差别攻击射杀，才能起到杀伤敌人地效果。而且火之国地伤亡必然是现在波风冥帝的数倍以上，而且这样命令一旦发出，可以想象地是，火之国的这个大名，终其一生将不会在得到来自军方的任何一点支持赞同！
军人自己甘愿牺牲，为国捐躯是一回事。那是值得歌颂赞扬，精神也是永垂不朽的，甚至是成为一个国家军队地灵魂之所在！但正在与敌人死命厮杀之中却被己方长官下令射杀，无论是不是出于迫于无奈，都将是完完全全的另一回事了！下达这个命令的军官，势必会受到全天下军人的鄙视！

见传令兵愣在那里。迟迟不肯传出命令，大名疯子一般的冲了过来，狠狠一马鞭抽在他脸上。满脸肌肉抽搐着咆哮道：“你tama的聋了？老子叫你放箭！快些放箭！”刷的一声，大名拔出武士道，狠狠指着传令兵前胸，微微一用劲，已经入肉三分，鲜血流出！大名面目狰狞地哭喊道：“再不下令，老子就先杀了你！快点！”大名气急败坏之下，说话全无礼仪风度可言，一国之大名。居然自称起了“老子”！
传令兵脸上现出恐惧之色，看一眼自己胸口的长剑，感到了刺骨的冰凉。终于手中令旗一挥，打出了放箭地命令！
这道命令一出，全军一片哗然！己方四十万大军对付敌人已不足三十人马，居然还要使用这等无差别攻击来消灭敌人，那等于是让自己一方第一线的战士陪葬啊？此令一出，此箭若发，岂不令全军将士心寒？但大名之令。谁敢违抗？就算再无奈也好，也只好引箭上弦！一声令下，万箭齐发！
自来也等人神色凝重的看着一路狂杀，高速前进的波风冥帝，见到他居然能这么轻易地来回冲破好火之国大军的严密合围，每一刀挥出必是一片血雨带着残肢飞洒而起，火之**中，无论是多么骁勇的悍将，无人能够拦阻波风冥帝哪怕一刀。甚至连稍稍的阻碍作用也是不能起到，阻拦波风冥帝面前，完全就只有去死这一条路了！
眼底不由得均是一片震惊之色！自来也自问是绝对做不到的，就是修炼一辈子也未必做的到！
波风冥帝这种人。刻下已经不能称之为忍者了！他，就是一个恶魔！一个专门为了战场shalu而生地恶魔！
忍者，这自来也自然看得多了，他们本身就是这样的忍者！然而但凡是人，不管他忍术多高，但总有杀人杀到自己心里也不舒服的时刻。只因为，敌人也是人，活生生的人！将一个跟自己一样的活生生的生命毁灭在自己手里，不管怎样，心中总会有一些异样的情绪。
但是现在在他们眼前的波风冥帝，却是完全超脱了这个范畴！颠覆了这个所有人公认的真理！波风冥帝在大军之中一个杀进，再一个杀出；在他那柄霸道之极的斩魄刀之下，新添亡魂早已不下一两万人！但从他依旧冷凛冷静的双目之中，看得出他丝毫没有为眼前自己一手制造出来的尸山血海所动，每一步的跨出，依旧是坚定有力，每一刀的挥出，依然是纵横捭阖，毫不留情！
这是一尊噬血的恶魔！是大名和三代，团藏将这恶魔引出来了，可是，他们却没有办法将他送走！

content_en:
The hearts of the three generations are extremely complicated! Shockingly, he said, "Uchiha Madara once fought against a million troops by himself, and it became a legend! No matter how strong the ninja is, how can he be stronger than thousands of troops? But this wave of Feng Ming Emperor did it just like Uchiha Madara did back then!"
Danzo's eyes almost jumped out of his head in shock! He knew that Emperor Namikaze was terrifying, but he didn't expect it to be so terrifying!
If only Danzo had known the true strength of Namikaze Hades earlier, he would be so powerful to such an appalling level! Even if you kill him, you won't establish such a strong enemy! Such characters. Is it easy to offend?
Isn't this courting death?
Danzo didn't expect that after spending his whole life calculating, he had miscalculated the true strength of Emperor Namikaze! While thinking about it. Emperor Namikaze is getting closer and closer!
The fighting with thousands of troops is still going on.
The hand of Namikaze Hades is like a fire, spreading terrible flames. With one knife, it will burn to death many people.
But Emperor Namikaze's cold eyes were not looking at the person he killed.
What Namikaze Hades looked at was the daimyo on the hillside, the third generation, Danzo!
For these three people, Emperor Namikaze has already given death orders in his heart! These three people had to die!
At this moment, Namikaze Hades' whole body had turned blood red from top to bottom! Naturally, Emperor Namikaze was not injured. No one could hurt Emperor Namikaze!
That's all the blood of the enemy.
In the eyes of the Fire Nation soldiers. This high-speed moving blood-red figure is an unrivaled demon that suddenly emerged from the sea of ​​​​blood in hell. Wherever he went, wherever he went, he could only see large swaths of broken limbs, smell the bloody storm, and hear the most piercing screams and wails!
All the enemies in front of Namikaze Hades couldn't help but tremble when they saw this terrifying demon rushing up, and their eyes were filled with fear! People can fight with others, even if that person is strong, evil, or superior, but people cannot fight with demons! Especially the peerless madman in front of him is really terrifying!
Now some of the soldiers of the Fire Country were actually trembling with the hands that raised their swords. Under the terrifying aura of Namikaze Hades, they had lost all will to fight, and the only thought in their minds was to turn around and run away! With such a sergeant and such morale, what kind of lethality can there be?
"Hurry up and shoot the arrow! Hurry up and shoot the arrow! Shoot him to death!! Shoot that devil to death!!! Quick, quick, quick..." On the hillside, the daimyo got up from the ground in fright, jumped to his feet, and roared at the top of his lungs! The voice was already mixed with countless hints of fear and horror, and there was even a hint of crying!
The daimyo was almost crying!
He didn't want to offend anyone, but he offended Emperor Namikaze! The Daimyo has never regretted so much in his life!
But the ordering sergeant next to him looked embarrassed. After all, Namikaze Hades and others are now completely mixed with the Fire Nation's army. How can arrows, a large-scale attack weapon, be able to work easily? The archers of the Kingdom of Fire cannot all be legendary archers, and even the archers cannot make mistakes in such an environment. If they really want to use arrows to annihilate the enemy, they must kill their own people indiscriminately to kill the enemy. Moreover, the casualties in the Country of Fire must be several times more than the current Emperor Namikaze, and once such an order is issued, it is conceivable that this famous name in the Country of Fire will not receive any support or approval from the military throughout his life!
It is one thing for soldiers to be willing to sacrifice themselves and die for the country. That is worthy of praise and praise, and its spirit is immortal. It can even become the soul of a country's army! But in the middle of a life-and-death fight with the enemy, he was ordered to be shot by his own superior. Whether it was out of helplessness or not, it would be a completely different matter! The officer who issued this order is bound to be despised by soldiers all over the world!
Seeing the messenger standing there, he was stunned. LateWhen he refused to give the order, the daimyo rushed over like a madman and whipped him in the face with a riding crop. The muscles on his face were twitching and he roared: "Are you deaf? I told you to shoot the arrow! Hurry up and shoot the arrow!" With a swipe, the daimyo pulled out his bushido and pointed at the chest of the order soldier. With a slight exertion, it had penetrated three-thirds of the flesh and blood flowed out! The daimyo cried with a ferocious face: "If you don't give the order, I will kill you first! Hurry up!" The daimyo was so angry that he spoke with no etiquette at all. The daimyo of a country. He actually calls himself "I"!
A look of fear appeared on the face of the messenger. He glanced at the sword on his chest and felt the biting coldness. Finally, he waved the command flag in his hand and gave the order to release the arrow!
As soon as this order came out, the whole army was in an uproar! Our own army of 400,000 people has less than 30 troops to deal with the enemy, and they still use such indiscriminate attacks to destroy the enemy. Is that equivalent to letting our own frontline soldiers be buried with them? As soon as this order is issued, if this arrow is fired, won't it chill the hearts of all the soldiers in the army? But the order of the Daimyo. Who dares to disobey? No matter how helpless it is, I have no choice but to cock the arrow! With one command, thousands of arrows fired!
Jiraiya and the others looked solemnly at Namikaze King, who was killing and advancing at high speed, and saw that he could so easily break through the tight encirclement of the Fire Nation army. Every time he swung a sword, a rain of blood would fly with the remaining limbs. In the ** of fire, no matter how brave the general was, no one could stop Namikaze King with even one strike. Even a slight hindrance cannot be achieved. In front of the Namikaze Hades, the only way to stop him is to die!
Their eyes couldn't help but be filled with shock! Jiraiya asked himself that he absolutely couldn't do it, even if he practiced for a lifetime, he might not be able to do it!
People like Namikaze Hades. You can no longer be called a ninja now! He is a devil! A demon born specifically for battlefield shalu!
Ninjas, Jiraiya has naturally seen a lot, they are such ninjas themselves! However, no matter how advanced a person's ninjutsu is, there will always be times when he feels uncomfortable when he kills someone. Just because the enemy is also a human being, a living human being! Destroying a living life like yourself in your own hands, no matter what, there will always be some strange emotions in your heart.
But the Namikaze Underworld in front of them now is completely beyond this category! Subverting this truth recognized by everyone! Namikaze Hades killed one by one in the army, and then one by one. Under his extremely domineering Zanpakutō, there were no more than 10,000 or 20,000 new dead souls! But from his still cold and calm eyes, it can be seen that he was not moved at all by the mountain of corpses and sea of ​​blood created by himself. Every step he took was still firm and powerful, and every knife he swung was still vertical and horizontal, without mercy!
This is a blood-devouring demon! It was the daimyo, the third generation, and Danzo who lured this demon out, but they were unable to send him away!
